scope: SFW visual novel event CG prompt blocks
quality_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres, safe
negative_base: worst quality, low quality, lowres, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, logo, multiple views, character sheet, collage, split screen, duplicate, cloned face, extra person, bad anatomy, malformed hands, fused fingers, extra fingers, extra limbs, disconnected limbs, floating tail, disconnected tail, extra tail, missing tail, extra horns, missing horns, wrong hair color, wrong costume, inconsistent lighting, flat staging, empty background
single_character_rules: Use one identity LoRA by default
Give gaze, shoulders, hands, body, feet, tail and one prop distinct jobs
Write at least one physical contact with the environment
Specify key, fill/bounce and separation light
multi_character_skeleton: EVENT INVOLVING BOTH CHARACTERS, two characters only, SHOT AND CAMERA, left character: IDENTITY A, ACTION A, GAZE A, CONTACT A, right character: IDENTITY B, ACTION B, GAZE B, CONTACT B, SHARED PROP OR CONTACT, DEPTH LAYERS, GLOBAL LIGHTING, FINISH
multi_character_rules: Use regional conditioning or separate masks when identity matters
Apply one identity LoRA inside each character region
Use a low-strength global pass to unify lighting
Inpaint faces, horns, clothes, hands, feet and tail connections separately
protected_character_rule: Laundry Dragonmaid / 小蓝 is SFW, wholesome, non-romantic and fully covered only.
